categories_thin: Keasbey: essentially industrial/logistics (group D, partly out of scope) - no consumer health or personal-care businesses surfaced, and only a handful of office-type firms can be mapped.
Hopelawn: small commercial strip along New Brunswick Ave; us-business.info carries only ~16 listings and several salons/barbers appear only through booking apps (Booksy, theCut).

Mental health / therapists: still thin - Psychology Today is the only working directory for the area and zencare returned HTTP 403; added The Center for Embracing Hope, but most individual Fords therapists remain uncaptured.

Med spas / wellness: thin - Skin Outspoken (phone now recorded) is the only dedicated skin/med-spa business; other candidates (e.g. Skin Clique provider Soraya Moreno) are individual injectors without a fixed local address, so they were not listed.
Physical therapy: added Fords Rehab LLC and Logos PT, but nearby PT is mostly in Woodbridge/Edison proper; Backsmart is the only other clinic in the zone.

Group C trades: only six firms are listed even after the verifier's additions, because Fords/Hopelawn/Keasbey contractors advertise mainly through Google/angi-style lead sites that were not openable from this environment.

Group D (retail, education, manufacturing): out of scope for this brief, so rows such as Tala Shruti School of Dance (14 Corrielle St) and Ideal Driving School (279 New Brunswick Ave), both on bestprosintown's Fords page, were not entered.
caveats: Main source is an aggregated local directory (us-business.info) that mixes current and legacy listings; entries marked 'one directory only' need triage confirmation before outreach.
Many Fords professional offices are single-attorney or single-CPA suites inside 720/786/860 King George Rd (Kings Road Office Center); they are separate firms sharing a building, not one business.

Removed in this revision after verifier findings: Spa Lady (multi-location NJ women's fitness brand; the 55 Lafayette Rd address is now Mauka Fitness), HomeWell Senior Care (franchise; no Fords office on the franchisor's own location pages), Hugh O. Habas DDS (predecessor of Craig S. Weinstein DMD at the same suite and phone per fordsdental.com), the 'Medical Co' placeholder row at 157 New Brunswick Ave (no operator identifiable), Joseph M. Sanzari Inc. at 670 King George Rd (company HQ is 100 West Franklin St, Hackensack; no Fords office confirmed), and Avaap Inc. at 2203 Sunnyview Oval (national consultancy; address looks like a registered/apartment address, no company page ties an office to Keasbey).

Two rows were merged/renamed rather than dropped: 'Insurance Solutions & Service Inc.' is now a single entry under Mitchell Insurance Services, Inc. (the name on Travelers' current Fords agency locator at the same suite and phone), and 'Opticare Physical Therapy' is now Logos Physical Therapy at the same address with the phone printed on logospt.com.
Some directory entries sit at residential-style addresses (e.g., 6 Webb Dr); those were mostly excluded to avoid home addresses. A few were kept where the listing is clearly a practice.
Fit-It 24/7 Fitness Club is kept but flagged: Yellow Pages also lists 'Flatiron Fitness' at 879 King George Rd, so the current trading name is uncertain.

Christine Valmy Skin Care shares a suite and phone with Arion Salon 57; Christine Valmy is a skincare-school brand, so this reads as an independent esthetician room rather than a chain branch - confirm before outreach.
Fords Rehab LLC shares its address and phone with Seeman Family Chiropractic and may be the same clinic's PT arm; kept as its own row for confirmation rather than silently merged.
data_gaps: Overpass / OpenStreetMap API unreachable (timeouts) - no OSM cross-check.
Yellow Pages, Manta, Big I New Jersey member directory, zencare, LocalityBiz and several aggregators returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare checks from this environment.
Woodbridge Metro Chamber of Commerce searchable member directory and the township's licensed-business list were not located in this pass.

Phones missing for businesses found only through booking apps or bestprosintown (Pro Hair, Jnshairstudio, Iron & Ivy, Jazzy Nail, Xclusive Styles grouped row, Design Hair Salon has phone but no confirmed street number for Xclusive, Skin Outspoken resolved, House of Melia, Jiva Hot Yoga, Backsmart resolved).
Central Air Mechanical phone unresolved (two conflicting numbers, neither on a page opened).
Xclusive Styles and Braids: street number and town unresolved (Hopelawn vs Perth Amboy listings).

Elite Roofing & Restoration and Carter & Sons Roofing: street addresses come from bestprosintown profiles; the companies' own sites do not print an address, so a map/Google Business check would confirm.
